title: ConfoVHH local-SE(3) DockQ development pilot

tiePolicy.averagePrecision: threshold-grouped non-interpolated AP; each complete tie block enters together
tiePolicy.auroc: Mann-Whitney formulation with 0.5 credit for positive-negative ties
tiePolicy.kendall: Kendall tau-b preserving score and DockQ ties
tiePolicy.precisionAtK: expected positive fraction when a boundary tie block crosses k
tiePolicy.successAtK: hypergeometric expected success when a boundary tie block crosses k

confovhh_evidence_v0_4.pointReference: paired macro average-precision difference versus all-tied baseline

contact_count.pointReference: paired macro average-precision difference versus all-tied baseline

delta_sasa.pointReference: paired macro average-precision difference versus all-tied baseline

clash_burden.pointReference: paired macro average-precision difference versus all-tied baseline

cdr_contact_share.pointReference: paired macro average-precision difference versus all-tied baseline

supportedVersusOtherOddsRatio.correction: 0.5 Haldane-Anscombe correction applied only to eligible tables containing a zero cell

cdrZeroContactPolicy.policy: A numbered pose with zero contacts receives CDR-contact-share score 0; a target is unavailable only when every retained pose is unnumbered.
cdrZeroContactPolicy.rationale: Prevents label-dependent row deletion and preserves the target-level denominator.

bootstrap.scheme: paired hierarchical cluster bootstrap: sample receptor-family clusters with replacement, then targets within sampled clusters; never resample poses
bootstrap.interpretation: development-target bootstrap dispersion interval, not external-generalization evidence

limitations: All five complexes were already used for development and public regression; this is not an independent holdout.
The native-derived local rigid-body grid omits wrong-patch docking, tangential slides, external-generator decoys, conformational flexibility, and non-binders.
DockQ measures similarity to a deposited source complex and does not establish binding, affinity, specificity, signaling, stability, or physiological validity.
Bootstrap intervals describe dispersion across five development targets and do not establish external generalization or statistical significance.
No thresholds or composite weights were fitted to DockQ labels, and the formal hard-decoy release gate remains unevaluated.
